text: You need to host a simple static website securely and cost-effectively on AWS. Which combination of services would be most suitable?

options.A: EC2 instance with Apache
options.B: S3 bucket configured for static website hosting
options.C: CloudFront distribution in front of S3
options.D: RDS database with a web server

text: A junior developer pushed a change to a GitHub repository, but the CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions) failed. The error message indicates a missing dependency.
code:
name: CI Pipeline
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

options.A: The `npm install` command might have failed due to network issues.
options.B: The `package.json` file might be missing or malformed.
options.D: The `npm test` command is trying to run before dependencies are installed.

text: You're trying to list all running Docker containers. Which command would you use?

options.A: docker ps -a
options.B: docker images

text: A Linux server is running low on disk space. You need to identify the largest files or directories in the current path to free up space.

options.A: ls -lh
options.B: du -sh *
options.D: find . -type f -size +1G -print0 | xargs -0 du -h | sort -rh | head -n 10

text: Your application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate is experiencing intermittent 503 errors. You suspect the containers are crashing or unhealthy.

options.A: Check the ECS service events for task stop reasons.
options.B: Review CloudWatch logs for the ECS tasks.
options.C: Inspect the ALB access logs for target group health checks.
options.D: Increase the EC2 instance size for the ECS cluster.

text: You need to store Docker images for your application in a private repository on AWS. Which service is designed for this purpose?

options.A: AWS S3
options.B: AWS ECR

text: An application deployed on Elastic Beanstalk is failing to start. The logs show a database connection error.

options.A: Check the security group rules for the RDS instance to ensure Beanstalk can connect.
options.B: Verify the database credentials in the Elastic Beanstalk environment properties.
options.C: Ensure the RDS instance is running and accessible.
options.D: Increase the instance count for the Elastic Beanstalk environment.

text: A user reports slow loading times for images on your website. The images are hosted in an S3 bucket.

options.A: Configure CloudFront with the S3 bucket as an origin.
options.B: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration for the bucket.
options.C: Move the S3 bucket to a region closer to the users.

text: You're setting up an ALB to distribute traffic to multiple targets. Which of the following are valid target types for an ALB?

options.A: EC2 Instances
options.B: IP Addresses

text: An IAM user is unable to access an S3 bucket, despite having an S3 policy attached. What could be a reason for this access denied error?

options.A: The S3 bucket policy explicitly denies access to the user.
options.B: The user's IAM policy is missing `s3:ListBucket` permission.
options.C: The user is trying to perform an action not covered by `s3:GetObject`.

text: You need to monitor the CPU utilization of your EC2 instances and receive an alert if it exceeds 80% for 5 minutes. Which AWS service would you use?

options.A: AWS Config
options.B: AWS CloudTrail

text: A Node.js application is deployed on an EC2 instance and managed by PM2. You need to restart the application after a code update.

options.A: pm2 stop <app_name> && pm2 start <app_name>
options.B: pm2 restart <app_name>

text: Your Docker image build is taking too long. You notice that dependencies are re-downloaded every time. How can you optimize the Dockerfile?
code:
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
CMD ["npm", "start"]

options.A: Use a multi-stage build to separate build and runtime dependencies.
options.B: Copy `package.json` and `package-lock.json` before `npm install`.
options.C: Add `RUN npm cache clean --force` after `npm install`.

text: You are debugging a `permission denied` error when trying to write to a file in Linux. What command would you use to check the file's permissions?

options.A: cat filename
options.B: ls -l filename

text: A GitHub Actions workflow is failing during the 'build' step with an error message indicating a missing environment variable. What could be the issue?
code:
name: Deploy
on: [push]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Build and Push
        run: docker build -t my-repo/my-app:latest . && docker push my-repo/my-app:latest
        env:
          DOCKER_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
          DOCKER_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

options.A: The secrets `DOCKER_USERNAME` or `DOCKER_PASSWORD` are not defined in the GitHub repository settings.
options.B: The `docker login` command is missing before `docker push`.
options.D: The `docker build` command requires environment variables.

text: Your application uses an AWS RDS MySQL instance. You want to improve read performance and provide high availability. What AWS features would you consider?

options.A: Enable Multi-AZ deployment for the RDS instance.
options.B: Create Read Replicas for the RDS instance.
options.C: Migrate the database to an EC2 instance.
options.D: Increase the storage size of the primary RDS instance.

text: You're developing a full-stack web application and want to use a service that handles frontend hosting, backend APIs, and database provisioning with minimal setup.

options.A: AWS EC2
options.B: AWS S3 + Lambda + API Gateway

text: A developer reports that their local Docker container runs fine, but when deployed to ECS Fargate, it crashes immediately. What could be the reason?
code:
FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["npm", "start"]

options.A: The container is trying to bind to a port that is not `EXPOSE`d in the Dockerfile.
options.B: The ECS task definition has incorrect resource limits (CPU/Memory).
options.C: The application inside the container is not listening on `0.0.0.0`.
options.D: The ECR repository policy prevents Fargate from pulling the image.

text: You want to ensure that your AWS spending does not exceed a certain limit each month. Which AWS service helps you track and set alerts for your budget?

options.A: AWS Cost Explorer
options.B: AWS Budgets

text: A critical application on an EC2 instance is consuming 95% CPU consistently. You need to identify the process causing this high load.

options.A: Use `top` command to view real-time process statistics.
options.B: Use `ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -n 10` to list top CPU-consuming processes.

text: You are setting up an ALB listener for HTTPS traffic. Which of the following are required configurations?

options.A: A valid SSL/TLS certificate.
options.B: A default target group.
options.C: A security group allowing inbound HTTPS traffic to the ALB.
options.D: An EC2 instance with a public IP address.

text: Your CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions) is failing because it can't connect to an external API. The error message is `Connection refused`.

options.A: The external API might be down or unreachable from the GitHub Actions runner.
options.B: A firewall or security group might be blocking outbound connections from the runner.
options.C: The API endpoint URL in the workflow configuration might be incorrect.
options.D: The GitHub Actions runner needs more memory.

text: You need to create a new IAM user for a developer with programmatic access only. Which type of credentials should you provide?

options.A: Username and password
options.B: Access key ID and secret access key

text: A Docker container running a Node.js application exits immediately after starting. You need to debug why it's not staying alive.

options.A: The `app.js` file might have a syntax error or unhandled exception.
options.B: The `CMD` instruction might be incorrect, not keeping the process in the foreground.
options.C: The container might be running out of memory.
options.D: The Docker daemon is not running on the host.

text: You're managing multiple Node.js applications on a Linux server using PM2. One application is consuming excessive memory, affecting others.

options.A: Use `pm2 monit` to observe real-time resource usage of processes.
options.B: Configure PM2 to restart the application if memory usage exceeds a threshold.
options.D: Use `pm2 delete <app_name>` to remove the problematic application.
